The '''''Runner 309''''' was the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of legendary [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nova (captain)|Nova]], although both the ship and the captain were often dismissed as urban legend.<ref name="TUR" />
